title: CERT-In Advisory   CIAD-2026-0039
content:
CERT-In Advisory  
                                                                      CIAD-2026-0039
Reports on Apple Threat Notifications
Original Issue Date: August    14, 2026
Description
Apple has issued threat notifications to users worldwide, including India, warning of sophisticated attempts by mercenary spyware operators to compromise Apple devices. These attacks are typically state-sponsored or carried out by highly resourced adversaries.
The notification advises users to adopt additional safeguards to secure data on their devices. Recommended measures include updating the iPhone to the latest available version (iOS 26.6) and ensuring that all other Apple devices in use are upgraded to their respective latest software releases. Users should also update messaging and cloud applications to the most recent versions and enable Lockdown Mode for enhanced protection against spyware threats.
Users are strongly urged to follow Apple's guidance and keep their devices updated. In addition, they are recommended to regularly consult CERT-In Vulnerability Notes and Advisories and apply the appropriate security patches to their devices to mitigate potential risks.
Any user who has received such a notification and wishes to have their Apple devices examined or avail technical assistance is requested to contact CERT-In via email at:
submitmobile@cert-in.org.in.
Note: Do not make any changes to the phone (resetting, deleting applications, updating, restarting etc.) as these actions could tamper evidence.
